## Passing integration

The strongest queued distinct-task candidate from the 2026-09-10 audit was rechecked against the current first-party Royal Road Fictions forum and admitted today:

**Royal Road “I forgot the title...”** — `https://www.royalroad.com/forums/5852`

The forum still describes the stable category as the place to ask for help finding a story previously read. That is a separate reader task from “recommend me another book”: a user may remember a scene, mechanic, setting, or protagonist but not the work's title. The route therefore adds **story identification** rather than another genre/topic recommendation thread.

The integration adds one WebNR-authored link-only row to `public/sources/web-novel-discussion-radar-starter/search_index.yml` and updates that source's audit documentation. Runtime synchronization still reads only local YAML. It performs no Royal Road API request, crawl, login, cookie use, pagination, post/comment copy, username copy, rating/view copy, story-text copy, or silent mirror. If Royal Road later moves or restricts the route, normal review corrects the local link and Git preserves provenance.

This increases the Discussion Radar from **10 to 11 entries** while leaving the maintained source-family count at **26**. The rollback boundary is one source row plus the corresponding README audit/provenance text; the previous ten-entry catalog remains a valid rollback point.

## Decisions

### Technical
No confirmed actionable defect was found before this change. Preserve the current reader, URL layout, analytics, docs, redirects, and deployment architecture.

### Source program
Ship one low-risk, task-level addition: the stable Royal Road forgotten-title category. Do not inflate the catalog with topical single threads whose semantics are already covered by Royal Road Recommendations. Maintain the link-only boundary because Royal Road's current access/rights rules do not support automated copying or crawling for this use.

### Content
Do not publish cadence filler while the 2026-09-09 substantial article is still inside the rolling 48-hour window.

### Search / community
Treat the five current Royal Road threads as qualitative route-shape evidence only. Do not convert reply counts, favorites, or individual recommendations into popularity statistics. The new story-identification route is useful because its task is distinct and its category URL is stable, not because of transient thread engagement.

### Measurement
Keep GA4/GSC and Cloudflare aggregates unavailable until provider evidence is actually available. Do not turn missing exports or unresolved Cloudflare account scope into zeros. The next weekly synthesis must respect the finalization lag.
